casia.sample_selection: 32 REAL/32 FAKE common-validation sources, fixed SHA-256 order, first filename per source; no prediction-based selection
casia.interpretation: Nonzero residual mismatch needs inspection of pairing, generation log and Pillow/JPEG versions; it is not automatically proof of corrupted training.

conclusion: Inspect regeneration parity and AUC as well as thresholded metrics. Any improvement here is secondary exploratory evidence; no parameters have been fitted or adopted.
